changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial.recurring_movements ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, name varchar(150) NOT NULL, type varchar(10) NOT NULL, value_kind varchar(10) NOT NULL, installments integer, first_installment integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, auto_launch boolean NOT NULL, active boolean NOT NULL, id_cost_center bigint NOT NULL, id_classification bigint NOT NULL, id_card bigint, CONSTRAINT recurring_movements_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT recurring_movements_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT ck_recurring_movements_on_type CHECK (type IN ('INCOME', 'EXPENSE')), CONSTRAINT ck_recurring_movements_on_value_kind CHECK (value_kind IN ('FIXED', 'VARIABLE')), CONSTRAINT ck_recurring_movements_on_installments CHECK (installments IS NULL OR installments > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_recurring_movements_on_first_installment CHECK (first_installment >= 1 AND (installments IS NULL OR first_installment <= installments)), CONSTRAINT fk_cost_centers_on_recurring_movements FOREIGN KEY (id_cost_center) REFERENCES registration.cost_centers (id), CONSTRAINT fk_classifications_on_recurring_movements FOREIGN KEY (id_classification) REFERENCES registration.classifications (id), CONSTRAINT fk_cards_on_recurring_movements FOREIGN KEY (id_card) REFERENCES registration.cards (id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_recurring_movements_on_cost_center ON financial.recurring_movements (id_cost_center); CREATE INDEX ix_recurring_movements_on_classification ON financial.recurring_movements (id_classification); CREATE INDEX ix_recurring_movements_on_card ON financial.recurring_movements (id_card);

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial.recurring_values ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, id_recurring_movement bigint NOT NULL, value numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, reason varchar(150), valid_from timestamp NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT recurring_values_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT recurring_values_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT ck_recurring_values_on_value CHECK (value > 0), CONSTRAINT fk_recurring_movements_on_recurring_values FOREIGN KEY (id_recurring_movement) REFERENCES financial.recurring_movements (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); CREATE INDEX ix_recurring_values_on_recurring_movement ON financial.recurring_values (id_recurring_movement, valid_from);

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial.recurring_launches ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, id_recurring_movement bigint NOT NULL, id_financial_period bigint NOT NULL, installment integer NOT NULL, id_movement bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT recurring_launches_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT recurring_launches_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT recurring_launches_id_movement_key UNIQUE (id_movement), CONSTRAINT uk_recurring_launches_on_recurring_movement_and_period UNIQUE (id_recurring_movement, id_financial_period), CONSTRAINT ck_recurring_launches_on_installment CHECK (installment >= 1), CONSTRAINT fk_recurring_movements_on_recurring_launches FOREIGN KEY (id_recurring_movement) REFERENCES financial.recurring_movements (id), CONSTRAINT fk_financial_periods_on_recurring_launches FOREIGN KEY (id_financial_period) REFERENCES registration.financial_periods (id), CONSTRAINT fk_movements_on_recurring_launches FOREIGN KEY (id_movement) REFERENCES financial.movements (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); CREATE INDEX ix_recurring_launches_on_financial_period ON financial.recurring_launches (id_financial_period);
